title: The git allowlist drops the unused merge-base --is-ancestor form
lead: `vcs.SHAPED["merge-base"]` accepts only `COMMIT COMMIT`, since nothing calls the `--is-ancestor` form any more, and the docs that describe the allowlist say so.
findings_note: s309 report 2026-10-16: nothing calls merge-base --is-ancestor after tips_outside; owner chose to remove the shape
boundary: **Not in this slice:** any other allowlist entry; the unrestricted `log` entry.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: s309 (landed 2026-10-16) replaced `verify --landed`'s per-tip `merge-base --is-ancestor` calls with two `log` calls in `vcs.tips_outside` and removed `vcs.is_ancestor`, its only caller. The `SHAPED` predicate (`src/slicer/vcs.py:46-50`) still admits `--is-ancestor COMMIT COMMIT`. AGENTS.md keeps the git allowlist closed, and an allowed form with no caller is surface that only widens it. On 2026-10-16 the owner chose to remove it as its own item, not inside s309.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/vcs.py`: `SHAPED["merge-base"]` accepts exactly two full commit names; update the comment above `SHAPED`.
- `tests/test_verify_landed.py:426-455`: the shape tests that run `--is-ancestor` now expect it refused (`StateError`, the allowlist code); keep the cases that prove options and short names are refused.
- `ARCHITECTURE.md:213` and `docs/commands.md:371`: `merge-base` takes only `COMMIT COMMIT`.
- `CHANGELOG.md` under Changed (security: a narrower git allowlist).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests and watch the first go red.
2. Narrow the predicate; update the existing shape tests and the two docs.
3. `rg -n "is-ancestor|is_ancestor" src tests docs ARCHITECTURE.md` finds only the refusal tests; mutation-check (re-admit the form).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - `python3.12 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch; the owner lands it.
